mentions.name: MouseTester
mentions.description: A simple, no-backend web tool that visualizes raw mouse input directly in the browser to diagnose common mouse issues like double-clicking and scroll wheel jitter, helping users tell hardware problems apart from software ones.
mentions.problem: The author kept running into common mouse issues like double-clicking and scroll wheel jitter and wanted a quick way to tell hardware problems from software ones.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve been working on a small side project to help diagnose common mouse issues like double-clicking and scroll wheel jitter.

It’s a simple, no-backend web tool that visualizes raw mouse input directly in the browser, mainly because I kept running into these issues myself and wanted a quick way to tell hardware problems from software ones.
